field.name: ut_base_tax
field.comment: UT base tax before taxpayer credit (computed)

field.name: ut_credit_phaseout_hoh
field.comment: UT taxpayer tax credit phase-out base, head of household: $27,320 for 2025, 1.5 times the single base as every year (TC-40 line 17). Derived from the single figure, not read from the 2025 instructions; confirm when a HOH Utah scenario is written.

field.name: ut_credit_phaseout_joint
field.comment: UT taxpayer tax credit phase-out base, married filing jointly or surviving spouse: $36,426 for 2025, twice the single base as every year (TC-40 line 17). Derived from the single figure, not read from the 2025 instructions; confirm when a joint Utah scenario is written.

field.name: ut_credit_phaseout_single
field.comment: UT taxpayer tax credit phase-out base, single: $18,213 for 2025 (TC-40 line 17; 2025 TC-40 instructions). The credit is reduced by 1.3% of Utah taxable income over this amount.

field.name: ut_military_retirement_credit
field.comment: Utah military retirement credit (computed per taxpayer by UT_Military_Retirement_Credit): a nonrefundable credit of 4.5% (the tax rate) of military retirement pay included in AGI, TC-40A Part 3 code AJ, Utah Code 59-10-1043; cannot be claimed with the retirement credit, code 18 (2025 TC-40 instructions p. 21-22). Utah has no exemption or AGI cap for the pay itself (#1330).

field.name: ut_military_retirement_taxable
field.comment: UT taxable military retirement after exemption (computed)

field.name: ut_personal_exemption
field.comment: UT personal exemption $2,111 per dependent for 2025 (TC-40 line 11; Utah Code 59-10-1018(1)(g)). It is a component of the taxpayer tax credit, not a deduction from taxable income.

field.name: ut_social_security_exempt
field.comment: UT fully exempts Social Security benefits from state income tax (2025). Source: Utah State Tax Commission

field.name: ut_social_security_exemption
field.comment: UT Social Security exemption amount (computed - full amount of SS benefits)

field.name: ut_state_tax
field.comment: UT state income tax (alias for ut_tax)

field.name: ut_tax
field.comment: UT final tax liability after credits (computed)

field.name: ut_tax_rate
field.comment: UT flat rate 4.5% (2025). Reduced from 4.55% by HB 106. Source: Utah State Tax Commission

field.name: ut_taxpayer_credit
field.comment: UT taxpayer tax credit (computed): 6% of (federal deduction + $2,111 per dependent), reduced by 1.3% of Utah taxable income over the filing-status base, not below zero (TC-40 lines 11-20; Utah Code 59-10-1018).

field.name: ut_taxpayer_credit_rate
field.comment: UT taxpayer tax credit rate - 6% of deductions and exemptions (2025). Source: Utah State Tax Commission
